node.title: Re^3: Get data from an XML file heading
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I didn't think it looked like XML Because it didn't have an ending and it has multiple values for one, node, I guess you would call it.

It's known as an "empty-element" tag, is equivalent to , and the values within the tag itself are attributes. See e.g. [https://www.w3schools.com/xml/].
